description: This file is a shell script that functions as a test suite for verifying the behavior of 'safe.directory' checks in a Git environment when running as root, including setup, permissions, and sudo-related operations.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for the presence of specific prerequisites for the test.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the content of two files or streams.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success and runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command must fail.

methods.name: run_with_sudo
methods.description: Runs provided commands with elevated privileges using sudo.
